objective: Decompose 60m abs(slope_t) scale into carrier, common-time, and identifiable clock/source components, and evaluate a normalized_strength diagnostic without changing V1 state semantics.

primary_decomposition.estimator: median-polish-style additive robust effects on log scale with zero-median identifiability constraints
primary_decomposition.normalized_strength_candidate: exp(residual) after removing estimated carrier_effect and common_time_effect

validation.out_of_time: fit carrier effects on first half of 2026 evaluation window and assess second-half stability; common-time factor remains contemporaneous diagnostic, not causal product semantics

regime_identifiability.rule: Do not relabel common-time effect as a causal regime effect. V1 state-conditional summaries are descriptive only because state is derived from the same score.

clock_source_identifiability.rule: Estimate a separate clock/source component only where the same carrier has an overlapping alternate source or clock view. If provider and clock change together, report the effect as confounded_source_clock rather than source-only or clock-only.

normalized_strength_diagnostic_supported: carrier scale dispersion is materially reduced without using carrier-specific future information
carrier factors are directionally stable out of time
residual scale is not dominated by a single carrier
clock/source confounding is explicitly bounded or marked unidentified
